name: yes.my current line-up - web, read-only (production)
note: Written by Phoenix on 16 Nov 2026 from the live Latest Devices row (iPhone 18 Pro / Pro Max, vivo X300 FE, Galaxy Z Flip 8 / Fold 8). Not from the YOS export: use release-web.json for the YOS cases. Each journey stops before any login, ID, TAC or payment step. Verified on the live page: iPhone 18 Pro (In Stock; storage 256GB-2TB; New Line / Existing; Infinite+ and Infinite Cashback; Cashback has No Contract and tiers Ultra/Premium/Standard/Basic) and vivo X300 FE (In Stock; one storage; Infinite+ only). The other devices are assumed to follow the same layout; a failure there is a finding about the suite or the page, not necessarily a defect. Every journey ends with 'Check that no error is showing' (the page must end clean, not just reach the last tap).
